subject: Boss Key
text: Defeating the two Stalfos extinguishes the flames around the chest containing the Boss Key.

evidence.quote:
Up at the next room you'll face two Stalfos. After
they're gone, the fire around the chest will disappear. Open it for the BOSS
KEY.

subject: Ganondorf
text: Ganondorf strikes Link with a beam of darkness that prevents Navi from assisting and disables target locking.

evidence.quote:
Ganondorf says a few words, then hits you
with a giant beam of darkness, preventing your Navi friend from helping you.
Uh oh! You can't lock on anymore!

subject: Ganondorf
text: When Ganondorf pounds the ground at the start of the battle, quickly roll away to the outer rim to avoid falling.

evidence.quote:
The boss starts out by pounding the ground. Quickly roll away to the outer rim
so you won't fall down.

subject: Ganondorf
text: Ganondorf's magic spell projectiles can be reflected back at him using sword swipes or Empty Bottles.

evidence.quote:
Ganondorf throws magic spells
that you have to reflect back at him with sword swipes. (Or oddly enough, Empty
Bottles)

subject: Ganondorf
text: When Ganondorf raises both arms to charge multiple magic spells, deflect the simultaneous volley using an Advanced Spin Slash.

evidence.quote:
When you see both his arms
raised and energy gathers toward him, he'll fire multiple magic spells at you
simultaneously. In order to deflect those, use the Advanced Spin Slash.

subject: Ganondorf
text: While Ganondorf is charging his multiple magic spell attack, shooting him directly in the face with a Light Arrow will interrupt him and save magic.

evidence.quote:
Another thing to do is that, when he's charging up
for that multiple magic spell attack, he's open for a Light Arrow to the face.

subject: Ganondorf
text: Once struck by a reflected spell, shoot Ganondorf with a Light Arrow before he recovers to bring him down, then slash him before he rises.

evidence.quote:
Once
he finally gets hit by a spell, quickly get the Light Arrows out and hit him
with one before he recovers. Once he's hit, he'll lower to the ground. Quickly 
get to him and slash him before he gets back up.

subject: Spin Attack
text: Quick spin slashes can be executed by rotating the control stick and immediately pressing the B button.

evidence.quote: Sword or do quick spin slashes. (Rotate stick then immediately press B)

subject: Princess Zelda
text: During the castle escape, Zelda becomes trapped in fire and Link must defeat Stalfos quickly to free her.

evidence.quote:
At one point she'll be trapped in
fire and you'll have to fight Stalfos. Be quick, as you don't have much time.
Once you free her, continue.

subject: Ganon
text: Ganon can be stunned with Light Arrows or passed by rolling between his legs, leaving his tail exposed to attacks from the Biggoron's Sword or Megaton Hammer.

evidence.quote:
The way to defeat this monster is to either stun it
by shooting Light Arrows then going behind it, or rolling between its legs.
Either way, slash his tail with the Biggoron's Sword. If you don't have it, use
the Megaton Hammer.

subject: Master Sword
text: Link is able to retrieve the Master Sword after dealing sufficient damage to Ganon.

evidence.quote:
After dealing some damage, you're able to get your Master 
Sword back.

subject: Ganon
text: Once Ganon collapses, Zelda restrains him while the sages empower Link's sword to strike the final blow to Ganon's head.

evidence.quote:
After some more damage, Ganon will 
fall, and Zelda will keep him down, telling you to deal the final blow. The 
sages will power your sword for the final hit. Just head up to his head, and
slash.

subject: Dungeon Map
text: In Master Quest Inside the Deku Tree, a chest reached after following the upper path contains the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote: Climb up using the ladder (the vines have Skullwalltulas on them that will knock you off) and follow the path up here, killing the Keese and the Gohma Egg here before it hatches. Open the chest for the DUNGEON MAP.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Rolling into the crate near the Dungeon Map chest breaks it and reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
roll 
into the nearby crate to break it, revealing a Gold Skulltula.

subject: Fairy Slingshot
text: Defeating all the Gohma eggs unlocks the door and spawns a chest in the alcove containing the Fairy Slingshot.

evidence.quote:
Kill the eggs on both the other ledge and in the
alcove, and on the wall to unlock the door and make a treasure chest appear in
the alcove. Open that to get the FAIRY SLINGSHOT.

subject: Blue Rupee
text: Lighting the center torch with a Deku Stick spawns a chest with a Blue Rupee, which holds a Deku Shield if the player lost theirs.

evidence.quote:
lighting it with a Deku Stick only spawns a treasure chest with a Blue
Rupee inside. (Though, chests with Blue Rupees inside usually have Deku Shields
in them if you lost yours.)

subject: Compass
text: Climbing the vines past the Big Skulltula leads to a chest containing the Compass.

evidence.quote:
Climb up them, kill the egg, and open the 
chest for the COMPASS.

subject: Webbing
text: Floor webbing can be burned by lighting a Deku Stick at a torch, standing on the webbing, and crouching with R to aim the stick downward.

evidence.quote:
See the
torch? Light a Deku Stick, stand on the webbing, and crouch (R) to point the 
stick at the webbing and burn it.

subject: Blue Rupee
text: Stepping on the switch after burning the webbing spawns a treasure chest containing a Blue Rupee on the previous ledge.

evidence.quote:
burn the webbing nearby. Step on the switch to make a treasure chest 
appear back on the previous ledge. The chest contains a Blue Rupee.

subject: Recovery Heart
text: A chest to the left upon entering the room contains a Recovery Heart.

evidence.quote: The chest to your left has a Recovery Heart inside.

subject: Spike Trap
text: While taking the moving platform across with a lit Deku Stick, duck to avoid the spiky trap, then light both torches on the other side to open the door.

evidence.quote:
Wait for the platform to get near you, take out a Deku Stick, light it, and
take the platform. Duck to avoid the spiky trap, then quickly light the two
torches here on the other side to make the door ahead open.

subject: Business Scrub
text: Reflecting a nut back at the Business Scrub allows Link to talk to him to purchase Deku Shields.

evidence.quote:
get rid of the Business Scrub by
reflecting one of its nuts and talking to it. (He sells Deku Shields)

subject: Deku Scrubs
text: Reflecting nuts at the three Deku Scrubs in the order of right, left, then center opens the door leading to the boss.

evidence.quote:
reflect a Deku Nut at the right Scrub, then the
left, then the center. Talk to the center Deku Scrub before it runs away, and
he'll give you tips about Queen Gohma before running away and opening the door
to the boss.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: In the Compass room, blowing up the rocks above the climbable vines with a Bombchu reveals a Gold Skulltula that can be retrieved with the Boomerang.

evidence.quote:
In the Compass room, there's some rocks right above some climbable vines. Use
 a Bombchu to blow them up, then climb up to kill a Gold Skulltula with the
 Boomerang.

subject: Purple Rupee
text: Playing the Song of Time near the blue block in the spike trap room removes it to reveal a chest containing a Purple Rupee.

evidence.quote:
In the room with the spike trap over a pool of water, there's a blue block.
 Play the Song of Time near it to remove it and reveal a chest containing a 
 Purple Rupee.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Playing the Song of Time in front of the gravestones in the four-torch room makes blue blocks appear leading to a Gold Skulltula on the ceiling.

evidence.quote:
There's a Gold Skulltula on the ceiling in the room with four torches with
 Keese resting on them. In order to reach it, you must play the Song of Time in
 front of the gravestones to make blue blocks appear leading up to the 
 Skulltula. Boomerang it to retrieve it.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Burning the northwest webbing in the four-torch room with a lit Deku Stick leads to a room where a Gold Skulltula token can be collected with the Boomerang.

evidence.quote:
burn the webbing on the northwest end of the room
 using a lit Deku Stick from the torches and enter the door. Kill all the
 enemies and use the Boomerang to get the Gold Skulltula and its token.

subject: Gossip Stone
text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby in front of a Gossip Stone spawns a free healing fairy.

evidence.quote:
(Play Zelda's Lullaby in front of a
Gossip Stone to get a free healing fairy.)

subject: Dungeon Map
text: In Master Quest Dodongo's Cavern, carrying a bomb flower from the main pillar to break the opposite cracked wall reveals a chest containing the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote:
grab a bomb flower, and go to the other side to break the nearest cracked wall.
Open the chest for the DUNGEON MAP.

subject: Staircase
text: Lighting the wall bomb flower with a Deku Stick and carrying it into the gap in the surrounding bomb flowers detonates the chain reaction to lower the staircase.

evidence.quote:
See the bomb flower on the wall?
Light a Deku Stick using the torch here, and light the bomb flower using the
Deku Stick, then immediately carry the bomb flower to the gap in the bomb
flowers surrounding the staircase to blow them all up and lower the staircase.
